notes: Hammam relates the scene («مر رجل على حذيفة»); Hudhayfa is the last link through «سمعت رسول الله». The man who passed by is only in the scene.
«قال سفيان والقتات النمام» is Sufyan's gloss on the word, not a link. The grading («حسن صحيح») is left out.
«حذيفة» occurrence 1 is in the scene (حذيفة بن اليمان); occurrence 2 is the speaker.
